tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground in entertainment mode (stage) and utility mode (paper). Netflix-style neutral near-black, never tinted. Every screen commits to one of the two.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Hover cards, menus, masthead on scroll, help notes.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Default elevated container: feature cards, FAQ rows, thumbnail placeholders. Never invent another charcoal.

tokens.name: hero-overlay
tokens.usage: Translucent fill over art: billboard badges, floating-label inputs and the email frame.

tokens.name: pill-active
tokens.usage: Fill of the active navigation pill (white at 20%).

tokens.name: pill-quiet
tokens.usage: Fill of the quiet pill button, More Info style (grey at 40%); text on it is ink.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unwatched remainder of a continue-watching progress bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-alt, hero-overlay and pill fills.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas, surface and surface-alt: inactive nav links, metadata, footers, legal.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Field and outline borders, outlined buttons, rating boxes (3:1 on canvas and surface).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers and decorative separators only; not for controls.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fork vermilion. The decision color: primary CTA, tags such as New Episode, progress fill, logo triangle. White text (on-brand) on it is 4.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand buttons. Action feedback only.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-hover and brand-pressed.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text on the white Play pill and white tags (ink-black in both themes).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The white Play pill and Watch Now tag fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in help, account and legal copy on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Score numerals and star glyphs next to a numeric rating, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text on canvas and surface; always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Billing or eligibility notices on canvas and surface; paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text on canvas and surface; paired with a word or icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every surface (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: rank-numeral
tokens.usage: Stroke of the oversized outlined numerals behind Top 10 posters (decorative, 3:1).

families.sans: "Archivo", "Noto Sans JP", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page H1 on help and account pages.

styles.name: body-strong

styles.name: tag

styles.name: pill-button
styles.usage: Play, More Info and in-app pill buttons.
